ruleDefinitions.name: Vulnerable WinRing0 Driver Load
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the load of a signed WinRing0 driver often used by threat actors, crypto miners (XMRIG) or malware for privilege escalation Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=D41FA95D4642DC981F10DE36F4DC8CD7.*") OR (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\WinRing0x64\\\.sys$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\WinRing0\\\.sys$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\WinRing0\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\WinRing0x64\\\.dll$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\winring00x64\\\.sys$")))
